blurb: Rockstar's return to Vice City, the most anticipated game in years, set for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19, 2026.
Capcom's creature-hunting epic holds an 89 OpenCritic rating from 206 critic reviews, placing it in the 99th percentile of scored games.
Playground's Japan-set open-world racer earned a 91 on OpenCritic, with 10/10 reviews from IGN, Eurogamer and VGC praising its varied roads and mountain routes.
A ground-up Switch 2 remake of the classic, with overhauled visuals, camera controls, a jump button, voice acting and a symphonic score; launches November 5, 2026.
The Switch 2 edition runs the remastered FFVII prequel at 1440p, up from 720p, with a 60fps performance mode; TheSixthAxis calls it the best version available to Switch 2 players.
Samus's first 2D adventure since Metroid Dread: a wounded hunter drains energy from foes to survive an alien moon. Switch 2, January 28, 2027, with amiibo.
Insomniac's Wolverine earns praise for brutally satisfying combat, strong visuals and voice work across a roughly 15-hour campaign, with 79 on OpenCritic and 78 on Metacritic (per 80.lv).
Apple's first foldable iPhone, with a 7.6-inch inner display reviewers say shows barely any crease, and an outer screen with a Center Stage camera. IP68-rated; ships Oct 23.
Reviewers praise the iPhone 18 Pro's variable-aperture main camera and excellent battery life, with the A20 Pro chip delivering M3-level performance, though the upgrade over the 17 Pro is modest.
Apple's biggest battery jump yet: rated up to 45 hours of video, and TechRadar and Tom's Guide lab tests ran 18h27m of browsing, beating the Galaxy S26 Ultra and Pixel 11 Pro XL.
Adds a new heart-rate sensor and Readiness, a daily 0-10 score from activity, sleep and vitals; reviewers call Readiness its most useful software addition, though it needs about a week of wear.
Apple's longest-lasting watch: rated up to 50 hours normal use and 84 in Low Power Mode, with a 5% larger battery than Ultra 3. TechRadar found it gets close to two full days.
Open-ear earbuds that still deliver active noise cancellation; reviewers call the ANC surprisingly effective for an unsealed design, though not at AirPods Pro level.
Apple says the M6 Mac mini is up to 4x faster at AI than the M4 model. Reviewers found a strong, tiny desktop with the best single-core speed of any Mac, though the $899 price rose.
Apple's M5 Max and M5 Ultra workstation claims up to 4.3x faster AI, up to 512GB of unified memory, and real-time color grading of uncompressed 8K footage. Independent reviews not yet found.
Midrange noise-canceling headphones with a 10-band equalizer to tune the sound.
Budget Sony headphones with active noise cancellation and up to 50 hours of battery; SoundGuys rates them 7.8/10.
A $99 portable CD player with Bluetooth, a USB-C rechargeable battery, 3.5mm and 4.4mm outputs, and a MagSafe-compatible ring mount on a semi-exposed disc design.
Eversolo's top Gen 2 streamer: DAC, preamp and top-loading CD player with OCXO clocking, a 10MHz clock input, AK4499EX DAC and a new 8.6-inch touchscreen.
Reviewers praise its big Dolby Atmos height, clear dialogue and bass that holds up without a sub; Engadget scored it 9/10 as a huge Atmos upgrade.
Sonos' $449 next-generation headphones: a 10-microphone ANC array, redesigned 40mm driver, up to 35 hours of battery and Headphone Linking to hand audio to Sonos speakers.
A half-size, more affordable take on the Move 2: IP67 waterproof, about 24 hours of battery, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and AirPlay 2, now in a new sand color.
Powered bookshelf speakers with a Tractrix horn tweeter and Cerametallic woofer, plus HDMI ARC for a TV.

A more sensitive E Series standmount with a custom 7.5-inch Satori carbon-cone driver, tuned for midrange focus and easy to drive from low-power amplifiers (Buchardt's claims, no independent review yet).
A 55th anniversary SL-1200 on the MK7 platform, limited to 12,000 units in seven colors with gold-anodized tonearm and gold details.
Roku's first OLEDs have 4K 120Hz panels with Dolby Vision and VRR. TechRadar praises the deep blacks and easy Roku interface at a budget price, but notes limited brightness in bright rooms.
Sony's entry-level 4K OLED has a 120Hz panel, Triluminos Pro color, Dolby Vision and four full-bandwidth HDMI 2.1 ports, a Sony first. It skips the XR Processor, in sizes from 48 to 83 inches.
A pocket gimbal camera with a Leica Summicron lens and 1-inch sensor shooting 8K/30 and true 4K vertical video. Engadget calls it a solid pick for Reels and Shorts; zoom is digital only.
A slim 5.4mm UWB tracker for Android's Find Hub with a year of battery life, a loud speaker and a Left Behind alert. Tom's Guide praises its repeating low-battery alerts; $29, on sale Nov 11.
The Caitlin Blue colorway of Caitlin Clark's debut signature shoe: forefoot Air Zoom Turbo for step-back spring, Cushlon midsole and a midfoot plate, $140.
The Warning Code colorway of Caitlin Clark's debut signature shoe: forefoot Air Zoom Turbo for step-back spring, Cushlon midsole and a midfoot plate, $140.
Crystal Dynamics' remake of the Atlantis story arrives for PC, Switch 2, PS5 and Xbox Series X/S; early hands-on previews call its visuals incredible.
Santa Monica Studio's next mainline God of War follows Faye (Laufey) in a new realm, exclusive to PlayStation 5, launching February 16, 2027.
Playground Games' Fable reboot, with a 15-20 hour main story and 'limitless' life systems, arrives February 23, 2027 on PC, PS5 and Xbox, day one on Game Pass.
The origin-story prequel scores 88 on OpenCritic, with critics singling out outstanding gunplay and polished combat; launched October 6, 2026 on Game Pass.
Meta's first camera-free smart glasses: 43 grams with open-ear audio, calls and Meta AI, up to 12 hours of battery plus 48 more from the case. $349, shipping October 13.
Part of Jordan Brand's 20-year partnership with Howard University, this Air Jordan 1 Low OG carries the school's navy and red with a mini Swoosh on the heel, a fall 2026 retail release.
A Gemstone Pack Air Jordan 41 with a 3D nano-print mesh upper, ZoomX midsole, full-length Zoom Strobel and double-stacked Air Zoom heel; the Ruby sold out on Nike's US page.
Nike's marathon racer claims about 10% more energy return from a new ZoomX LT layer over a carbon Flyplate, at roughly 208g; early testers found it more stable and smoother than the Alphafly 3.
Patek's first wristwatch to show sunrise and sunset times, with a corrector for summer and winter time, in a 47 mm white-gold case with a rotating star chart and moon phases.
Eight Bioceramic pocket watches inspired by the Royal Oak, from about $400 with new hand-wound Sistem51 movements; reviewers call it playful and an affordable entry to the Royal Oak look.
A 50-piece manual-winding tourbillon whose skeletonised movement echoes a Colnago racing frame, in the debut Azure Blue Quartz TPT with a titanium baseplate.
Tyrese Haliburton's first signature shoe, designed with Salehe Bembury, runs NITROFOAM cushioning under a lightweight mesh upper, and it debuted on court in the 2025 NBA Finals for $130.
Tim Hardaway's 1997 Air Bakin returns in its original Black and Varsity Red, with a padded ribbed upper, Max Air in the heel and extra Air in the forefoot.
A streamlined low-top take on the rugged Air Max Goadome boot, in croc-embossed Midnight Navy leather.
The second croc-embossed Goadome Low of the autumn, in all-black leather, $175.
Tom Sachs' first premium General Purpose Shoe: a perforated ECCO leather upper in black with blue seat-belt-nylon pull tabs, inspired by his school-days Swoosh blackout.
Hypebeast's full-collection rundown highlights a shearling B-15 flight jacket, GORE-TEX WINDSTOPPER and Pertex patchwork parkas, returning Realtree camo and a 2000 AD Judge Dredd capsule.
Teddy-bear-shaped glass cold cup from Starbucks' 2025 holiday line; it sold out nationwide at launch and drew resale listings far above its $30 retail price, with fans camping out for it.
Happy Meal trick-or-treat pails in five characters (ghost, pumpkin, goblin, new black cat and red zombie), each with three face variations for 15 designs to collect.
Limited Pokémon 30th anniversary acrylic cup holding Original Glazed Gold Dots, sold alongside six Pokémon doughnuts in several Pokémon designs for a few weeks only.
Stanley's limited 2026 Halloween drinkware in two designs, Black Magic and Bordeaux Lace, led by the 40 oz Quencher H2.0 tumbler, priced $30 to $50.
Every 14-card Play Booster in the 30-pack display holds a legendary card plus its Echoverse alternate, for a Standard-legal set that closes Jace Beleren's story arc, at $5.49 a pack.
Star Trek's 60th-anniversary Magic set: 30 Play Boosters of 14 cards each, with a foil and at least one rare or better per pack; releases November 13, 2026.
The 4th-anniversary One Piece Card Game set takes the Straw Hats to Elbaph, alongside the Four Emperors and Rocks D. Xebec.
Bandai's second Heroines Edition extra booster for the One Piece Card Game, built around the series' heroines.
Bandai's official page bills the 18th booster as the World Government's greatest power, with 127+1 card types and Saint Gunko and Saint Shamrock debuting, at $4.99 a pack.
Nine Pitch Black booster packs plus an exclusive full-art Zarude promo, 65 sleeves, 40 Energy cards, damage dice, a coin-flip die and a divided collector's box, all headlined by Mega Darkrai ex.
Elite Trainer Box for the 30th Celebration set: 9 booster packs, a Nidorina promo, 16 foil Energy, 65 sleeves and dice, with a Pikachu in every pack across 30 Pikachu variations.
Mega Rayquaza ex returns to the TCG after a decade-plus, in an over-135-card set with paired Legendary Stadium cards forming one extended artwork; out November 6, 2026.
Chosen by Red Line Club members (41.74% of the casting vote), this ZAMAC Porsche 959 has a lifting rear hood showing the engine and debuts gold-hub Real Riders BB wheels.
Medicom Toy's Coca-Cola BE@RBRICK pair pairs a translucent contour-bottle bear with a red can bear, each in 100% and 400% sizes, as a display-ready collector set.
4,711-piece Highclere Castle model with 13 Season 6 minifigures; Brickset praises the cast and the upstairs/downstairs interiors, while noting some void spaces and repetitive building.

6,130-piece, 136 cm UCS Executor, the longest LEGO Star Wars brick model yet; Brickset praises its display presence, engineering and minifigures, but finds the box awkward and the underside lacklustre.
1,911-piece replica of the original PlayStation with a working CD tray and Power button, a buildable controller and two 90s game dioramas; Brick Banter calls the controller authentic and comfortable.
Limited convention-exclusive Funko Pops sold from booth #4515 at New York Comic Con, 8 to 11 October, by reservation or random virtual queue, led by a One Piece Young Big Mom.
A $49.99 bundle for Lorcana's 14th chapter: a full-art storage box, eight boosters, dividers and dice, with Coco's Rivera family debuting; due October 23, 2026.
Limited to 1,969 numbered pieces, with a dial, hands, crown and pushers in Omega Moonshine gold, 11 g of gold in all, in a 42 mm Bioceramic case; a nod to Apollo 11.
A one-day, Spain-only MoonSwatch tied to the 12 August 2026 total eclipse, with a black Bioceramic pusher evoking the eclipse and a New Moon caseback.
A stool developed from the Xbox controller's original 3D design files, with a grip texture that helps keep you seated just as it keeps a thumb from slipping, in IKEA's nine-piece Xbox collection.
sacai's third Levi's collab is a 12-piece collection; the Sherpa Jacket is a relaxed selvedge indigo shell wrapped in faux sherpa with leather pocket detailing, a limited edition at $795.
Everything for a 3-vs-3 game of Gunpla tabletop combat: six unpainted 50mm miniatures, two intro scenarios and unit stats for each suit, at a £34.99 RRP.

A Vlaada Chvátil and Tomáš Holek collaboration for Czech Games Edition: an open-world, deck-building euro for up to 4 players plus a solo mode, where you grow through quests, alchemy, combat or persuasion.
A Gen Con preview called it a favorite among card-drafting games, simple to teach and crunchy in about 45 minutes, with 61 unique mercenaries and 1 to 6 players for $24.99.
Hickman and Matteo Della Fonte reimagine the X-Men as a vampire-versus-mutant war in New York, leading Marvel's horror Midnight line with Marvel's distinctive "Cloaked Covers".
Exquisite Corpses co-creator Michael Walsh writes and draws a six-issue Irish-folklore horror western, with Hex facing an otherworldly evil in the town of Ashecott.
A horror-tinged coming-of-age manga whose Yen Press volume 1 sits in the mid-4s on Goodreads (about 4.4 from tens of thousands of ratings), now heading to its final chapter.
Titan's anniversary edition marks two decades of Yoshinaga's mecha manga: a pilot who cannot use magic uncovers an ancient Golem, which led to an anime film series and TV show.
Winner of the 2011 Shogakukan Manga Award (general) and Kodansha Manga Award, Space Brothers follows two brothers' astronaut dreams across 46 volumes and nearly 18 years.
Togashi's series has passed 100 million copies in circulation worldwide, per Shueisha, and VIZ's volume 1 is the starting point for its long-awaited new chapters.
Collects Snyder and Dragotta's Absolute Batman #1-14 in a premium hardcover; the run draws strong reader scores (Goodreads issue averages around 4.3 to 4.6) and praise for Dragotta's art.
Dan Panosian writes and draws a retro-style five-issue adventure in which Logan leaves the X-Men and lands in Miami's criminal underworld, with Dazzler along for the ride.
A 100-player, three-team tactical FPS with vehicles, destructible maps and proximity voice chat, rated Mostly Positive (79%) by English Steam reviewers in Early Access at $39.99.
The Norse survival game graduates from Early Access with the Deep North update, and Steam reviewers rate it Very Positive at 94% across 265,389 English reviews, with a Metacritic score of 89.
Mega Crit's iconic roguelike deckbuilder returns with five characters, two of them new, and up to 4-player online co-op.
A free-to-play open-world creature-catching RPG where you glide, dive and burrow across Idyll and "Twine" with your Aniimo, Mostly Positive (72%) on Steam.
A collectable tin of 12 milk chocolate KitKat F1 cars, part of KitKat's Formula 1 partnership and the top gift in Nestlé's biggest-ever Christmas range; RRP £10.
A 90g hollow Cadbury Dairy Milk bauble you smash open to find Freddo faces treats inside. The wrapper even has a hole so the foil can hang on the tree. Morrisons lists it at £2.70.
A Cadbury chocolate ball with a crunchy Biscoff filling, part of an expanded Cadbury and Lotus Biscoff Christmas tie-up. Sold singly at £0.98 or as a 3-pack at £3.29.
New bat-shaped sour gummies for Halloween in orange, green apple or cherry, each with blackcurrant. A wholesale and convenience exclusive in a 140g £1.25 bag.
Lotte's strawberry Koala's March collab with idol group CUTIE STREET: 32 biscuit designs and 5 limited packs to hunt for your favourite member. 46g bag, 181 yen, convenience stores and kiosks.
Lotte's winter-limited liqueur chocolates return: Rummy (rum raisin with fresh chocolate, 3.7% alcohol, on sale since 1965) and Bacchus (cognac in milk chocolate, 3.2%). About 356 yen.
Hi-Chew Crisp Fruit Mix gives Fuji apple and Kosui pear in one chew with a crisp bite, plus the first Umai-Chew assortment of green apple, peach and mandarin.
Morinaga turns its Black Moon chocolate biscuit into a semi-soft galette sandwich with rich chocolate cream, on sale nationwide for a limited time from 6 October 2026.
Nongshim's Neoguling blends Onion Ring snack saltiness with the spicy seafood flavour of Neoguri ramyeon, turning a viral social-media snack hack into a product. Launches 12 October.
An Aussie take on pig-shaped sweets: a berry-cherry gummy topped with a fluffy foam layer for two textures, from better-for-you brand Funday. 50g bag, $4.50 at Woolworths.
A limited-edition Mr Whippy collab of strawberry and vanilla ice cream cone gummies with a soft, foamy texture, in a 50 g bag for $4.50 at Woolworths.
Soft gummy centres coated in tangy crunchy crystals, in Original and Tropical Splash. Sporked gave both a 10/10, praising a gummy texture that is neither too firm nor too chewy.
Girl Scouts' first allergy-friendly cookie, made with Partake: a crunchy vegan, gluten-free, nut-free oatmeal chocolate chip cookie with sprinkles, sold online from 12 January 2027.
Six limited editions for Seiko's 145th anniversary in Edo purple with gold accents, including a 7,000-piece Prospex Alpinist and a 2,000-piece Astron GPS Solar chronograph.
The Bioceramic Omega x Swatch Speedmaster-style collection of 11 models, a cheap entry to Omega's moonwatch look that drew queues worldwide at launch in March 2022.

The only known steel Ref. 1518 of its kind sold for CHF 14.19 million at Phillips, the most expensive vintage Patek wristwatch ever sold at auction; it first launched in 1941 as a perpetual calendar chronograph.
Headline of Rolex's Oyster centenary: a 41 mm Oyster Perpetual with '100 Years' on the dial, caliber 3230 with about 70 hours of power reserve, and 100 m water resistance.
Tudor's centenary Monarch is a 39 mm integrated-bracelet sports watch with a papyrus-toned dial and snowflake hands, 100 m water resistance and a Master Chronometer movement per The 1916 Company.
The first Galaxy Watch on Snapdragon Wear Elite, with five years of promised updates; reviewers call it a solid but incremental upgrade with a big performance jump.
Garmin's flagship multisport watch with a 3,000-nit AMOLED display and 64 GB map storage; TechRadar calls the Pro a near-perfect performance watch, though pricey.
